title: What’s New in Wedding Premium: Schedule, Menu, Song Requests and Photo Bingo
description: Guestcam Wedding Premium now includes a wedding schedule, digital menu, DJ song requests, photo bingo, unlimited photos and videos, and unlimited storage and access.
author: Guestcam Team
tldr: Wedding Premium now combines the QR gallery with a wedding schedule, digital menu, DJ song requests, photo bingo, unlimited photos and videos, and unlimited storage and access.

content.text: Wedding Premium is no longer just a gallery for collecting guest photos and videos. It has grown into a digital wedding experience for the organiser, guests and DJ — all available on a phone with no extra app to install.

items: Live Photo Wall, ZIP download and other Premium features.

content.text: 1. Wedding schedule guests can check anytime
Add guest arrival, ceremony, photo session, dinner, first dance, cake and other moments. Guests can open the schedule from the same QR experience and quickly see what happens next.
The wedding menu sits alongside the gallery and schedule, so guests can check meal information directly from their phones.

content.alt: Wedding guests seated at a reception table

content.text: 3. Song requests sent directly to the DJ
Guests can submit a song title, artist and their name. The DJ gets a separate protected view where requests can be accepted, marked as played or declined.

Photo bingo turns guest photography into a game. Challenges can include the first dance, a funny moment, a group of friends or a decoration detail. Guests can upload a photo directly to a challenge and progress is tracked automatically.
Wedding Premium includes unlimited photo and video uploads plus unlimited storage and access time. The organiser can also download the gallery content as a ZIP archive at any time.
Wedding Premium is currently €84 instead of the regular €129 — 35% off for a limited time.
Everything stays connected to one QR code
Guests do not need to install an app or create an account. One QR code opens the gallery and wedding features, while the organiser manages everything from the Guestcam dashboard.

content.q: Are the new wedding features included in the same Wedding Premium package?
content.a: Yes. The schedule, menu, song requests and photo bingo are included in Wedding Premium.

content.q: Can guests still use it only as a photo and video gallery?
content.a: Yes. The QR gallery remains the core experience. The wedding features are optional and can be used when needed.
No. Wedding Premium includes unlimited photos and videos.

content.q: How long does the gallery stay available?
content.a: Wedding Premium includes unlimited storage and access time.

content.q: How much does Wedding Premium cost now?
content.a: The regular price is €129. The current limited-time promotional price is €84, which is 35% off.
